card.text: Explore Aemilia in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Nonconvex shape inferred from light curves, with a published occultation size. The grid marks unavailable imagery.

shape.title: ISAM SAGE 102 shape model
shape.summary: Nonconvex SAGE light-curve reconstruction with a published occultation volume-equivalent diameter of 135 ±7 km. An alternative pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotation phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: ISAM SAGE 102 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the SAGE shape model minus a 67.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
